info.title: JailAPI – Secure
info.description: All endpoints return a `type` field (`Success` or `Error`). HTTP 200 = success, 400 = validation error (`message` explains why), 500 = unhandled exception (`fullError` contains the stack trace). See each response schema for field-level details.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The SmartKey application ID issued to your integration.

parameters.name: requestDT
parameters.description: Current UTC timestamp in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss format. Example: 2026-05-18T14:30:00

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: HMAC verification hash. Compute as: SHA256(UTF8(ApiKey + AppId + "&" + requestDT)).ToHexString().ToLower()

chargeReferenceNumber.description: Reference number for this charge, resolved from its charge catalog entry. Null if the charge has no catalog linkage (e.g. arrest-imported charges not yet reconciled against the catalog).

bondAmount.description: Bond amount set for this individual charge (distinct from the case-level BondAmount — bond can be set per charge and gates release per charge).

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier for this charge. Read-only.

bookingAgency.description: Name of the agency that booked this charge, resolved from the case's agency (JBCASE.AGENCYNAME) — the same value for every charge on a given case, since booking agency is not tracked per-charge in the underlying data.

bookingAgencyAbbreviation.description: Abbreviation/code for the agency that booked this charge, resolved from the case's agency (JBCASE.AGENCY, e.g. "SRSO") — the same value for every charge on a given case, since booking agency is not tracked per-charge in the underlying data.

goc.description: GOC (Group Offense Code) for this charge.

gocDescription.description: Human-readable description of GOC, resolved from the agency-configurable GOC catalog. Null if GOC has no catalog linkage.

domesticViolence.description: Whether this charge is flagged as domestic violence related.

obts.description: OBTS (Offense-Based Tracking System) number, resolved from the case's own OBTS number (JBCASE.OBTS) — the same value for every charge on a given case, since OBTS is assigned per arrest/booking event, not per-charge.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier for the case. Read-only — do not modify. Use this with `GET /Cases/GetCase` to retrieve the full record.

courtCaseNumber.description: Court case number assigned once the case is filed with the court. Null/empty for cases not yet filed.

active.description: Whether the case is currently active.

cancel.description: Whether the case has been cancelled.

judgeName.description: Name of the judge associated with the case.

createdDateTime.description: Date and time the case was created.

changedDateTime.description: Date and time of the most recent change to this case.

bondType.description: Bond type: "Bond By LEO", "Bond By Judge", "No Bond", or null if no bond info has been entered.

bondAmount.description: Bond amount, applicable when BondType is "Bond By LEO" or "Bond By Judge". Null otherwise.

isInmateReleased.description: Whether the subject has been released — their booking record has moved from JAILBOOK to the JBHISTO archive. Some Person fields (Street) aren't tracked historically and may be null for a released subject even though the case itself still has valid data.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier for the case. Read-only — do not modify. Returned by the system and used to identify this case in follow-up API calls.

createdDateTime.description: Date and time the case was created.

changedDateTime.description: Date and time of the most recent change.

arrestDate.description: Date and time of arrest (JBCASE.ARR_DATE/ARR_TIME). Falls back to the subject's booking date (JAILBOOK/JBHISTO.BOOKDATE) when arrest date wasn't recorded on the case. Null if neither is available.

courtCaseNumber.description: Court case number assigned once the case is filed with the court. Null/empty for cases not yet filed.

active.description: Whether the case is currently active.

cancel.description: Whether the case has been cancelled.

judgeName.description: Name of the judge associated with the case.

facility.description: Facility where the subject is held.

isInmateReleased.description: Whether the subject has been released — their booking record has moved from JAILBOOK to the JBHISTO archive. Some fields (JudgeName, Street) aren't tracked historically and may be null for a released subject even though the case itself still has valid data.

bondType.description: Bond type: "Bond By LEO", "Bond By Judge", "No Bond", or null if no bond info has been entered.

bondAmount.description: Bond amount, applicable when BondType is "Bond By LEO" or "Bond By Judge". Null otherwise.

bondOptions.description: Bond options currently selected for this case, resolved from the agency-configurable bond option catalog (same entries as GET /Config/GetBondOptions). Pass the UniqueKey values back on JailCaseUpdate.BondOptions to update this case's selections.

bondConditions.description: Bond conditions currently selected for this case, resolved from the agency-configurable bond condition catalog (same entries as GET /Config/GetBondConditions). Pass the UniqueKey values back on JailCaseUpdate.BondConditions to update this case's selections.

bondConditionOther.description: Whether the "Other" bond condition is checked.

bondConditionOtherComments.description: Free-text comments for the "Other" bond condition.

externalValidations.description: External validation results submitted via SendExternalValidationResult.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier of the case to update. If supplied, must match the request's top-level UniqueKey.

active.description: Whether the case is currently active.

cancel.description: Whether the case has been cancelled.

courtCaseNumber.description: Court case number assigned once the case is filed with the court. Null/empty for cases not yet filed.

judgeName.description: Name of the judge associated with the case. Free text — not validated against a catalog.

bondType.description: Bond type: "Bond By LEO", "Bond By Judge", or "No Bond". Null leaves the case's existing bond type/amount completely untouched — this is NOT a full-replace field like the 4 above.

bondAmount.description: Bond amount. Only meaningful when BondType is "Bond By LEO" or "Bond By Judge"; ignored (defaults to 0) otherwise. Only read when BondType is non-null.

bondOptions.description: CfgBondOption.UniqueKey values to associate with this case. Null leaves existing bond options completely untouched. An empty list clears all bond options. A populated list replaces the full set.

bondConditions.description: CfgBondCondition.UniqueKey values to associate with this case. Null leaves existing bond conditions completely untouched. An empty list clears all bond conditions. A populated list replaces the full set.

bondConditionOther.description: Whether the "Other" bond condition applies. Null leaves the existing value untouched.

bondConditionOtherComments.description: Free-text comments for the "Other" bond condition. Null leaves the existing value untouched; empty string clears it.

externalValidationID.description: External validation ID provided by the vendor.

submittedDateTime.description: Date and time the result was submitted.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier for the movement. Read-only — do not modify. Use this with `GET /Movements/GetMovement` to retrieve the full record.

bookingNumber.description: Booking number linked to this movement.

movementDateTime.description: Date and time the movement occurred.

changedDateTime.description: Date and time of the most recent change to this movement.

movementType.description: Single-character movement type code, matching JBMOVE.MOVETYPE (varchar(1)). Use `GET /Config/GetMovementTypes` for the current reference set.

description.description: OPTIONAL. Move description, may include information about source/destination of move.

judgeUniqueKey.description: Reference key (CFGJUDGE.UniqueKey) of the judge associated with this movement's court event, if any. Use with `JudgeName` to display the judge's name.

judgeName.description: READ-ONLY. Name of the judge referenced by `JudgeUniqueKey`, resolved from the judge configuration catalog. Null if `JudgeUniqueKey` is null or unresolvable.

moveCompletedFlag.description: Whether this movement's court event has been completed (has a result set) and no longer requires inmate movement.

cancelled.description: Whether the movement has been cancelled.

inProgress.description: Whether the movement is currently in progress (transport underway).

courtUniqueKey.description: Reference key (CFGCOURT.UniqueKey) of the court associated with this movement, if any. Use with `CourtName` to display the court's name.

courtName.description: READ-ONLY. Name of the court referenced by `CourtUniqueKey`, resolved from the court configuration catalog. Null if `CourtUniqueKey` is null or unresolvable.

locationUniqueKey.description: Reference key (CFGMOVE.UniqueKey) of the external destination (e.g. hospital, other agency) for this movement, if any. Use with `LocationName` to display the location's description.

locationName.description: READ-ONLY. Description of the location referenced by `LocationUniqueKey`, resolved from the location configuration catalog. Null if `LocationUniqueKey` is null or unresolvable.

isInmateReleased.description: Whether the subject has been released — their booking record has moved from JAILBOOK to the JBHISTO archive. Some Person fields (Street) aren't tracked historically and may be null for a released subject.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier automatically generated by the system. Use this to identify the movement in follow-up calls (e.g. as UpdateMovement's UniqueKey).

movementDateTime.description: Date and time the movement occurred.

movementType.description: Single-character movement type code, matching JBMOVE.MOVETYPE (varchar(1)). Use `GET /Config/GetMovementTypes` for the current reference set.

description.description: Move description, may include information about source/destination of move.

judgeUniqueKey.description: OPTIONAL. Reference key (CFGJUDGE.UniqueKey) of the judge associated with this movement's court event, if any. Must be an existing judge configuration UniqueKey — do not pass a judge's name here.

judgeName.description: READ-ONLY. Name of the judge referenced by `JudgeUniqueKey`, resolved from the judge configuration catalog.

moveCompletedFlag.description: READ-ONLY. Whether this movement's court event has been completed and no longer requires inmate movement.

cancelled.description: READ-ONLY. Whether the movement has been cancelled.

inProgress.description: READ-ONLY. Whether the movement is currently in progress (transport underway).

courtUniqueKey.description: OPTIONAL. Reference key (CFGCOURT.UniqueKey) of the court associated with this movement, if any. Must be an existing court configuration UniqueKey — do not pass a court's name here. Use `GET /Config/GetCourts` for the current reference set.

courtName.description: READ-ONLY. Name of the court referenced by `CourtUniqueKey`, resolved from the court configuration catalog.

locationUniqueKey.description: OPTIONAL. Reference key (CFGMOVE.UniqueKey) of the external destination (e.g. hospital, other agency) for this movement, if any. Must be an existing, non-internal location — use `GET /Config/GetLocations` for the current reference set. Internal destinations (dorms/cells/facilities) cannot be used here.

locationName.description: READ-ONLY. Description of the location referenced by `LocationUniqueKey`, resolved from the location configuration catalog.

isInmateReleased.description: READ-ONLY. Whether the subject has been released — their booking record has moved from JAILBOOK to the JBHISTO archive. Some Person fields (Street) aren't tracked historically and may be null for a released subject.

createdByPerNo.description: OPTIONAL. Personnel number who created/authorized the movement.

notes.description: OPTIONAL. Free-text notes about this movement.

example.notes: Dorm move entered by classification desk.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier automatically generated by the system. DO NOT SET on CreateMovement requests — leave as null. Include only when updating an existing movement to identify which record to modify; if supplied on UpdateMovement, must match the request's top-level UniqueKey.

mniNumber.description: MNI number of the subject. At least one of MNINumber/BookingNumber is required. If both are supplied, they must refer to the same JAILBOOK/JBHISTO record — a mismatch is rejected. If only MNINumber is supplied, it must resolve unambiguously to a single active booking (or, absent an active match, a single historical one).

bookingNumber.description: Booking number. At least one of MNINumber/BookingNumber is required. Must match an existing JAILBOOK/JBHISTO record.

movementDateTime.description: MANDATORY. Date and time the movement occurred.

movementType.description: MANDATORY. Single-character movement type code, matching JBMOVE.MOVETYPE (varchar(1)). Must be one of GET /Config/GetMovementTypes' known codes (C, E, D, F, O) — matching is case-insensitive, and the value is normalized to uppercase before being saved. Any other value is rejected.

description.description: OPTIONAL. Move description, may include information about source/destination of move.

judgeUniqueKey.description: OPTIONAL. Reference key (CFGJUDGE.UniqueKey) of the judge associated with this movement's court event, if any. Must be an existing judge configuration UniqueKey — do not pass a judge's name here.

courtUniqueKey.description: OPTIONAL. Reference key (CFGCOURT.UniqueKey) of the court associated with this movement, if any. Must be an existing court configuration UniqueKey — do not pass a court's name here. Use GET /Config/GetCourts for the current reference set.

locationUniqueKey.description: OPTIONAL. Reference key (CFGMOVE.UniqueKey) of the external destination (e.g. hospital, other agency) for this movement, if any. Must be an existing, non-internal location — use GET /Config/GetLocations for the current reference set. Internal destinations (dorms/cells/facilities) cannot be used here.

createdByPerNo.description: OPTIONAL. Personnel number who created/authorized the movement. If omitted, defaults to the calling application's authorized API identity (e.g. "CivitekJail") rather than being left blank.

notes.description: OPTIONAL. Free-text notes about this movement.

moveCompletedFlag.description: OPTIONAL. Whether this movement's court event has been completed and no longer requires inmate movement — direct pass-through to JBMOVE.COMPLETE. Null leaves the existing value untouched on UpdateMovement (defaults to false on CreateMovement, which has no prior value).

cancelled.description: Whether the movement has been cancelled — direct pass-through to JBMOVE.CANCELED. Always submitted (full-replace, no leave-alone semantics), matching UpdateCase.Cancel. Defaults to false on CreateMovement, which has no prior value.

inProgress.description: OPTIONAL. Whether the movement is currently in progress (transport underway) — direct pass-through to JBMOVE.InProgress. Null leaves the existing value untouched on UpdateMovement (defaults to false on CreateMovement, which has no prior value — a movement is not usually created already in progress, but the field is not rejected if supplied).

houseNo.description: House number of the primary subject's address.

physicalAddress.description: Free-text physical address for the primary subject, distinct from the structured Street/City/State/Zip breakdown above.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier for this subject's JAILBOOK record. Read-only.

height.description: Height, as recorded at booking (free-text format, e.g. "5'10").

weight.description: Weight in pounds, as recorded at booking.

idNo.description: State-issued identification number, sourced from MNI (not tracked in JAILBOOK). Null if MNI enrichment is unavailable or no ID is on file.

idState.description: State that issued IdNo, sourced from MNI (not tracked in JAILBOOK). Null if MNI enrichment is unavailable or no ID is on file.

phoneNumber.description: Primary phone number for the subject, sourced from MNI. Read-only.

aliases.description: Known aliases (alternate names) for the subject, sourced from MNI. Read-only.

mniLastName.description: MNI's current last name for this subject. Only present when it differs from LastName and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniFirstName.description: MNI's current first name for this subject. Only present when it differs from FirstName and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniSuffix.description: MNI's current name suffix for this subject. Only present when it differs from Suffix and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniSex.description: MNI's current sex code for this subject. Only present when it differs from Sex and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniRace.description: MNI's current race code for this subject. Only present when it differs from Race and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniHeight.description: MNI's current height for this subject. Only present when it differs from Height and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniWeight.description: MNI's current weight (in pounds) for this subject. Only present when it differs from Weight and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniEyeColor.description: MNI's current eye color code for this subject. Only present when it differs from EyeColor and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniHairColor.description: MNI's current hair color code for this subject. Only present when it differs from HairColor and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniSSN.description: MNI's current Social Security Number for this subject. Only present when it differs from SSN and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniDateOfBirth.description: MNI's current date of birth for this subject. Only present when it differs from DateOfBirth and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

mniAddress.description: MNI's current address for this subject, formatted as a single display string (e.g. "123 Main St, Springfield, FL 32301"). Only present when it differs from (or fills a gap in) the Street/City/State/Zip fields above and MNI's demographic data was modified more recently than JAILBOOK's — signals a possible sync gap between the two systems.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier for this alias record (MNI_AKA.UNIQUEKEY). Read-only.

suffix.description: Alias name suffix (e.g. "Jr", "Sr", "III"), sourced from MNI_AKA.TITLE.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth associated with this alias, if known.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier for this judge configuration entry. Use this value as `JudgeUniqueKey` on CreateMovement/UpdateMovement. Read-only — do not modify.

active.description: Whether this judge configuration entry is currently active.

uniqueKey.description: SmartCOP internal identifier for this location. Use this value as `LocationUniqueKey` on CreateMovement/UpdateMovement. Read-only — do not modify.

active.description: Whether this location is currently active.

code.description: Movement type code value (matched to a movement's type).

description.description: Human-readable description of the movement type.

pageNumber.description: Current page number (1-indexed). Reflects the PageNumber sent in the request. Default: 1.

pageSize.description: Number of records per page. Reflects the PageSize sent in the request. Default: 50. Maximum: 500.

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the query across all pages.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages for this result set. Calculated as ceil(TotalCount / PageSize).

hasNextPage.description: True if there is a next page available. Use this to determine whether to request PageNumber + 1.

hasPreviousPage.description: True if there is a previous page available (PageNumber > 1).
